adaptations.reason: The benchmark repository has no upstream tags, so `git describe` fails under `set -e` and package_source stops. Not needed if upstream tags are pushed to the benchmark repository.

build.yml job deploy (environment Deploy): creates GitHub releases with the token, sleeps 300 s and pushes images to Docker Hub with secrets that do not exist here. Upstream's if: kept, 'false &&' in front, so it is off in every configuration. Known parity difference in kit.md: the replay does not include deploy or its 5-minute sleep
